prior_year_events.event_name: Adverse experience on third party liability
prior_year_events.impact_description: Adverse experience on third party liability led to prior period reserve deterioration

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2018 the syndicate had gross claims outstanding of GBP 164.182m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a net prior-year strengthening (adverse development) of approximately GBP 10.65m (6.5% of opening gross reserves), driven largely by adverse development in older casualty/third-party liability cohorts. The managing agent narratives report a net prior period deterioration of GBP 5.2m (net of reinsurance), primarily due to adverse experience on third party liability; the gross triangle was used to derive the aggregate gross movement because the movement table in the notes appeared to present net figures.
raw_causal_phrases: Prior period reserve deterioration was GBP 5.2 million (2017: deterioration of GBP 10.8 million) primarily due to adverse experience on third party liability
The prior year's net provision for claims outstanding generated a deficit for 2018 (2017: deficit)

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' appears to present net (after reinsurance) movements; therefore the gross prior year movement was derived from the gross claims development triangle. The managing agent narrative reports a net prior-period deterioration of GBP 5.2m (net of reinsurance). The gross triangle indicates a gross adverse movement of approx. GBP 10.65m. Lob-level movements taken from the movement note are likely net of reinsurance and thus have lower confidence for representing gross movements.
